parameters.name: Ttl
parameters.description: The blocking duration. Valid values: **60** to **86400**. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: Uri
parameters.description:
The check path.

>  You cannot modify the Uniform Resource Identifier (URI). The domain name of the website, the check path, and the rule name uniquely identify a rule.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo modify-web-cc-rule --resource-group-id default --domain www.aliyun.com --name testrule --act close --count 3 --interval 30 --biz-mode prefix --ttl 60 --uri /abc --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ddoscoo ModifyWebCCRule --region cn-hangzhou --Act close --ResourceGroupId default --Mode prefix --Count 3 --Domain 'www.aliyun.com' --Ttl 60 --Uri '/abc' --Name testrule --Interval 30
